extract_fields.ExporterName: the value printed next to the first 'EXPORTER NAME:' heading
extract_fields.ExporterAddress: the value printed next to the 'ADDRESS:' heading directly below 'EXPORTER NAME:'
extract_fields.PackerName: the value printed next to the 'PACKER NAME:' heading
extract_fields.PackerAddress: the value printed next to the 'ADDRESS:' heading directly below 'PACKER NAME:'
extract_fields.ImporterName: the value printed next to 'IMPORTER NAME :'
extract_fields.ImporterAddress: the address lines printed next to '&' and 'ADDRESS:' beneath 'IMPORTER NAME :', combined into one block (do not include the importer name itself)
extract_fields.FSSAILicense: the number printed next to 'FSSAI LICENSE NUMBER:'
extract_fields.PackingDate: the value printed next to 'Packing Date:'
extract_fields.LotNumber: the value printed next to 'Lot number/Code number/Batch number:'
